reason: Two length classes, 90-106 aa and 137-143 aa, are the documented biology of this genus and not a mixed bin. PMID 15163762 states in one sentence "FHV, 106 amino acids; NoV, 134 and 137 amino acids", and PMID 12573589 detected both Nodamura forms (B2-134 and B2-137) by MALDI-TOF, arising from the first and second AUG of subgenomic RNA3. Pariacoto B2 is 90 aa (PMID 10799587). So the short mode is FHV/BBV/Boolarra/Pariacoto and the long mode is Nodamura and its close relatives -- species-level length variation in one protein, with every member in the +1 frame relative to protein A. Splitting the bin would build two profiles for one gene; the alternative-initiation pair within Nodamura cannot be separated by any profile anyway, since B2-134 is B2-137 minus three N-terminal residues.
